title: The Origin and Value of Disagreement Among Data Labelers: A Case Study of Individual Differences in Hate Speech Annotation
reasoning: The paper develops a multidimensional scale for hate speech annotation that explicitly incorporates 'Moral violation' (defined by moral standards such as sanctity and care) and 'Radicalization' (covering religious and political ideals) as key constructs. The study evaluates how annotators perceive and judge these moral and religious dimensions within speech content.
